name: portfolio
description: TankOS. No build step: this file only holds dev tooling (Playwright regression tests). Nothing here is deployed.

scripts.test:docker: docker run --rm --ipc=host -v "$PWD":/work -w /work -e CI -e TANKOS_VISUAL=1 mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.63.0-noble npx playwright test
scripts.test:docker:update: docker run --rm --ipc=host -v "$PWD":/work -w /work -e TANKOS_VISUAL=1 mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.63.0-noble npx playwright test --update-snapshots
